top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Fed Hikes and Signals More to Come: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks fell after the Federal Reserve lifted interest rates for the first time since 2023 to fight persistently high inflation, signaling the possibility of further tightening.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
